system.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain the Guide Equipment Action. The recipient still chooses its own Action and targets.

Guide (EC03)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / One willing ally other than yourself

Effect: Choose an ally you can detect that can perceive your guidance. Its next Action before the start of your next Turn gains 1 free Surge. Multiple Guides on one ally do not stack. This grants no additional Action and never determines the ally’s choice.

Design note: No roll, no success gate, no Surge options. No social compulsion or automatic persuasion.
system.flavor: Simple tactical support without controlling another character.
